notes.title: Tornado level can be set, new add player bug fixed, extended tornado ground time
notes.notes:
In the freedom play mode, the tornado level can be set (level 0-6)!
The birth location of the newly added player will be on the map, and the props can be picked up and can harm each other with the tornado.
In the freedom play mode, extend the stay time of the tornado on the ground.
Tornadoes have a lot of synchronization data, and the number of tornadoes that can be set in freedom play mode is determined by the player's Network bandwidth.  
There will be an unlimited number of challenges in the stand-alone version, look forward to it.
